answer_1.quote: We study the ability of language models to reason about plans composed of a sequence of intermediate goals for completing basic object manipulation tasks in a household environment specified using text instructions.
answer_1.outputs: sequences of subgoals represented in natural language text

answer_2.quote: We use top-k recall to evaluate the ability of language models to generate plans from instructions by comparing against ground truth plans. In addition, we also evaluate the performance of an agent acting in the AI2-Thor simulator to complete tasks using task success rate.
